title: Tenure relief of the restocking share on HMO straight-tip returns: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
On the Urology and Continence Supply Program, a long-standing Continence Commercial HMO Program has the restocking basis relieved on returned straight-tip intermittent catheters (A4351). The relief is set by how long ago the program became active.

## Relief by tenure

| Program became active, counted in whole calendar months before the credit | Restocking basis |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | multiplied by three quarters (0.75) |
| at least 12 but fewer than 24 | multiplied by nine tenths (0.9) |
| fewer than 12 | not changed |

Whole calendar months are counted from the program's activation date to the credit date, with a partial month not counted.

## Boundaries (hypothetical; credit on 10 June)

- Activated 10 June two years earlier: 24 whole months, so the restocking basis is multiplied by 0.75.
- Activated 11 June two years earlier: 23 whole months, so it is multiplied by 0.9.
- Activated 11 June of the previous year: 11 whole months, so the restocking basis is not changed.
